question: 17|Which country has the lowest global resilience score?
query: To find the country with the lowest global resilience score, you can use the following SQL query:  ```sql SELECT country_name, global_development_resilience_index FROM global_development_indicators ORDER BY global_development_resilience_index LIMIT 1; ```  This query will return the name of the country with the lowest global resilience score.
